architect: The Architect stands motionless, blueprints etched into stone.
Every structure begins as chaos, before it becomes intent.
I do not build by accident. I build by design.
...Look closer. Nothing here was left to chance.
chronicler: The Chronicler remembers everything — even the mistakes.
I did not begin as I am now.
I learned by breaking things, then wondering why.
seeker: The Seeker never stays still for long.
A new tool. A new question. That's enough to start.
I take things apart not to understand them, but to see what they could become.
Curiosity isn't a phase. It's a rhythm.
duelist: The Duelist has fallen more times than most.
Discipline wasn't given to me. It was earned, one fall at a time.
Balance isn't the absence of struggle. It's what remains after it.
I carry that lesson into everything I build.
dreamsmith: The Dreamsmith listens to worlds that don't exist yet.
Stories shaped me long before code did.
Every idea I've built started as something I once imagined.
Some call it distraction. I call it material.
pathfinder: The Pathfinder doesn't follow roads. It makes them.
Somewhere ahead is something worth building. I just haven't found it yet.
I don't code only to solve problems.
I code to see what happens next.
